svg.title: freeform · material · light
svg.desc: OrderFlow worked example. ViewBox 2200x1100. Three region columns (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-south-1) each with surfaces + API gateway + 4 services + data tier. Cross-region RDS replication. Single global Snowflake warehouse. External integrations panel.
svg.text: Three regions · one platform · ~120k orders/day · p99 < 1.2 s intake · wide-variant 2200 canvas

g.text: REST · OIDC · idempotency-key dedup · p99 < 1.2 s

svg.text: Primary writer · global read fan-out to eu-west-1 + ap-south-1 (async).

g.text: REST · GDPR · data residency = EU only

svg.text: Read replica of us-east-1 · GDPR-locked · writes failover only.
Regional writer · low-latency edge for APAC traffic · feeds warehouse hourly.

g.text: Order events · GMV · inventory snapshots · finance reconciliation
single global resource · all 3 regions feed it via Snowpipe (continuous)
us-east-1 (primary) → eu-west-1 (read replica · GDPR) · ap-south-1 (regional writer · APAC).
All three regions feed the global Snowflake warehouse via Snowpipe continuous ingestion.

svg.text: solid arrow (info-blue) = sync / replication · dashed arrow (muted) = async / scheduled handoff · region boundary = VPC edge
